import hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, parse_qs

base = Path('products/services/catalogue-inquiry-completeness')
source = base / 'current-public-offer.html'
checker = Path('products/services/merchant-v1-group-id-sample/runnable-controls/check.py')
raw = source.read_bytes()
expected = '8bb6898a489669b02cd4db20f10abbe524a2d87b4c4590d233b49d337eb83bcc'
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == expected

class Offer(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.parts = []
        self.templates = []
        self.suppressed = False

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in {'script', 'style', 'head'}:
            self.suppressed = True
        if tag in {'p', 'li', 'h2', 'h3', 'br'}:
            self.parts.append('\n')
        href = dict(attrs).get('href', '')
        if tag == 'a' and href.startswith('mailto:'):
            query = parse_qs(urlsplit(href).query)
            self.templates.extend(query.get('body', []))

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in {'script', 'style', 'head'}:
            self.suppressed = False
        if tag in {'p', 'li', 'h2', 'h3'}:
            self.parts.append('\n')

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.suppressed:
            self.parts.append(data)

parser = Offer()
parser.feed(raw.decode('utf-8'))
terms = re.compile(r'famil|group|identif|variant|paste|collez|plain text|texte brut', re.I)
visible = [' '.join(line.split()) for line in ''.join(parser.parts).splitlines() if terms.search(line)]
controls = {
    'family_labels_missing': ('offer_id,item_group_id\nO1,G1\nO2,G1\n', 2, None),
    'family_labels_supplied': ('expected_family,offer_id,item_group_id\nlamp,O1,G1\nlamp,O2,G1\n', 0, {'conflicting_families': {}}),
    'group_conflict': ('expected_family,offer_id,item_group_id\nlamp,O1,G1\nlamp,O2,G2\n', 1, {'conflicting_families': {'lamp': ['G1', 'G2']}}),
}
runs = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    for name, (csv_text, expected_code, expected_report) in controls.items():
        fixture = Path(directory) / (name + '.csv')
        fixture.write_text(csv_text, encoding='utf-8')
        command = [sys.executable, str(checker), str(fixture)]
        run = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        report = json.loads(run.stdout) if run.stdout.strip() else None
        runs.append({'case': name, 'command': command, 'synthetic_input': csv_text, 'input_sha256': hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'exit_code': run.returncode, 'stdout': run.stdout, 'stderr': run.stderr, 'matches': run.returncode == expected_code and report == expected_report})
result = {'scope': 'Public offer excerpts and offline checker controls. Human interpretation of bilingual wording and buyer behavior remain unverified.', 'source': str(source), 'source_sha256': expected, 'checker_sha256': hashlib.sha256(checker.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'visible_candidate_excerpts': visible, 'public_prefilled_body_lines': [line for body in parser.templates for line in body.splitlines() if terms.search(line) and '@' not in line], 'controls': runs, 'all_controls_match': all(run['matches'] for run in runs)}
output = base / 'director-visible-intake-and-checker-controls.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

The next check reads the visible English and French offer alongside the email template and runs the existing checker against fictional inputs. This will help determine whether the intake needs a wording change. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so buyer demand is unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
